auditorRole: independent novelty-closure auditor; no score, acceptance threshold, or acceptance prediction used
auditQuestion: Do the v7 fixed-converter cohort execution and v7 preflight implement the narrow E1-E4 residual identified by release-lineage-novelty-audit-v4: a cooperative-perception-specific physical-event-by-ego-by-actual-cooperator normative population, independently projected from the released artifact and an actually executed fixed generator, content-bound to source/archive/index/commit/metainfo, and enforced by an unavoidable pre-execution equality gate with a real semantic witness that generic hashes, schemas, and provenance miss?

baseline.exactEquivalencePolicy: All E1-E4 are required. Aggregate counts, schema compatibility, file checksums, generic lineage, metadata, and optional custom checks are not exact equivalents.
requiredConditions: E1: normative canonical release population with physical event, temporal extent, ego identity and role, actual cooperating cohort, split, and every population-changing filter or loader option
E2: independent released-side and fixed-generator-side mechanical derivations
E3: signed or content-addressed binding of release, projections, generator source and environment, inputs, parameters, and manifests
E4: unavoidable fail-closed equality verification before every official training or evaluation entrypoint

sourceBoundVerdict.disposition: reject novelty closure; retain only the bounded factual execution result
sourceBoundVerdict.reason: The current converter was actually executed and the two stored-index cooperator lists were independently parsed, but the passing comparison is a generator-defined 90-row vehicle-ego subpopulation rather than the independently derived 120-row released population. The normative schema omits loader-dependent actual-cooperator semantics. The latest verifier does rederive both projections from pinned source bytes and rejects tested one-sided forgeries, but the checked preflight certificate and tests are stale against that verifier, the bindings remain unsigned and environment-incomplete, and the standalone default gate is neither unavoidable nor full-population by default.
sourceBoundVerdict.externalCollisionDisposition: No targeted primary source examined at the cutoff implements the complete E1-E4 package. SimBEV2X, OpenCOOD/OPV2V, V2Xverse, in-toto, Croissant, DataLad, data-contract tooling, and benchmark audits remain strong partial collisions. Their generic capabilities make broad provenance, manifest, certificate, reproducibility, fail-closed inspection, schema, or first-audit claims indefensible even though no external exact collision was located.

For those same 90 canonical scenario/timestamp/ego keys, the stored per-row cooperators[].agent_id lists equal independently restricted-parsed lists from the corresponding released rows. The released pickle nevertheless contains 120 rows, including 30 released-only ego-0 rows, and its raw dataset label is OPV2V rather than the generated CooperScene label.

criticalFindings.title: 90-pass is a generator-defined projection of a 120-row release
criticalFindings.evidence: deriveReleasedProjection validates all 120 rows, then defaults to filtering with VEHICLE_EGO_IDS=['1','2','3']; the same constant defines the generator population. Full-released mode reports 30 released-only ego-0 keys.
criticalFindings.effect: The passing comparison is not independent canonical release-population equality.

criticalFindings.title: Stored cooperators are not a complete actual-cooperator contract
criticalFindings.evidence: The converter stores every other parsed agent, while the official CoopDataset later applies com_range, agent_setting, delay behavior, and max_cav truncation. None is in the v7 projection or binding.
criticalFindings.effect: E1 is incomplete and the checker can pass while runtime cohort semantics change.

criticalFindings.title: Default execution does not fail on the real complete-population mismatch
criticalFindings.evidence: The default vehicle-egos command emits a pass certificate; --scope full-released is optional. buildCertificate catches the full mismatch and continues successfully.
criticalFindings.effect: The demonstrated semantic witness does not drive mandatory fail-closed behavior.

criticalFindings.title: The source-bound verifier fix invalidates the checked preflight artifact and its test contract
criticalFindings.evidence: Against runner SHA-256 2443b3ca694a72688f7eb334d5084441e96bda934ad2cbaebacad6e3f932117a, verifyCertificate rejects the checked preflight file with CERTIFICATE_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH. A current rerun succeeds only into a temporary artifact with whole-file SHA-256 dfc72cb592698e04d90caec8fc6a27101e94af37f3cfd7008ac91a97285c9dee. The checked preflight tests report 5 passes and 9 failures because they still exercise the old API and old artifact hashes.
criticalFindings.effect: The current source contains stronger verifier logic, but the repository does not contain a source-consistent checked certificate or a passing regression contract for it.

criticalFindings.title: OPV2V-to-CooperScene is a local alias, not raw identity
criticalFindings.evidence: Raw metainfo comparison fails at $.dataset. The released pickle says OPV2V and the current converter says CooperScene. The alias is hard-coded by the candidate and has no authoritative signed source statement.
criticalFindings.effect: Raw metainfo parity and historical generator identity cannot be claimed; the alias must remain an explicit local policy or the mismatch must fail.
